$bog_feedback2_form_not_ready: Feedback storage is not ready yet, try again
$bog_gram_Gate_fresh_note_title: If this is your first time in Gram on this device, create an account. It will be shared by all apps on this domain.
$bog_gram_Intro_hint_title: Or start a new one: the button in the list header
$bog_gram_call_card_count_none: Nobody here now, tap to join
$bog_gram_chat_call_lost_pattern: Call not started: key not delivered — {names}. Call again a bit later
$bog_gram_chat_images_capped_pattern: Only the first {limit} photos were sent: at most {limit} at a time
$bog_gram_chat_lost_pattern: {what} not sent: key not delivered — {names}. Send again a bit later
$bog_gram_chat_video_big_pattern: Video over {limit} MB cannot be compressed, this one is {size} MB
$bog_gram_chat_video_over_pattern: Video does not fit: {size} MB after compression, the limit is {limit} MB
$bog_gram_chat_voice_denied: Microphone unavailable: allow recording in the browser settings
$bog_gram_compose_Join_plate_text_title: You are not in this registry: others will not find you here
$bog_gram_compose_users_alone: Nobody else is in the registries yet
$bog_gram_compose_users_none: You are not in any registry. Create your own in settings
$bog_gram_group_lost_pattern: Keys not found: {names}. Without a key a person cannot read the chat, but the group can be created without them.
$bog_gram_members_Admin_note_title: An admin gets full control of the land: they can both invite people and change other people's rights. These abilities cannot be split.
$bog_gram_members_Drop_note_title: "Remove" starts a new chat compartment without the person. Past messages stay with them: the key to them is already given and cannot be taken back. They will not see new ones.
$bog_gram_members_History_all_hint: Give keys to all past messages
$bog_gram_members_History_head_title: What the new member will see
$bog_gram_members_Join_hint_title: You will not join instantly with it: whoever follows it sends a request, and you have to accept it, since the key to the chat is given to a person by name
$bog_gram_members_Leave_note_title: "Leave" removes the group from your list. It stays for the others, and so do your past messages in it.
$bog_gram_members_drop_hint_armed: Really remove? Past messages will stay with them
$bog_gram_members_error_bad: This does not look like an identifier
$bog_gram_members_history_all_note: The new member will get keys to all past group messages
$bog_gram_members_history_new_note: We will start a new chat compartment: the past stays closed, and everyone will see only what is written next
$bog_gram_music_account_note: The Music account is shared with Gram: key, chats and downloaded tracks are the same in both apps. There is no reset here: it would erase the Gram account, and the tracks would be deleted too. You can switch the account in Gram, but the tracks will be deleted too.
$bog_gram_settings_Follow_hint_title: Or scan someone else's QR: the chat, group or registry opens right here, not in the browser
$bog_gram_settings_Invite_hint_title: Send this link: the chat with you opens right away for the other person
$bog_gram_settings_Logs_open_title: Open the log of events and errors
$bog_gram_settings_Name_field_hint: Your name: only your contacts see it
$bog_gram_settings_Registry_empty_title: You are not in any registry
$bog_gram_settings_Registry_note_title: You can only remove it from your own list: the entry in the registry itself stays forever.
$bog_gram_settings_Registry_share_text_t: Invitation link to the active registry
$bog_gram_settings_key_Load_hint_title: Or upload a file with the key
$bog_gram_settings_key_Warning_title: A key is full access to the account. It is the same for all apps on this domain, including Music. Do not show it to anyone and do not publish it.
$bog_gram_settings_key_error_bad: This does not look like an account key
$bog_gram_settings_key_error_empty: Paste the key or upload a file
$bog_gram_settings_key_error_qr: The QR does not contain an account key
$bog_gram_settings_key_import_sure: Really sign in? The current account will be replaced
$bog_gram_settings_link_unknown: Link not recognized: a Gram link to a person, group or registry is needed
$bog_gram_text_alerts_later: We will ask for permission when you open a conversation
$bog_gram_text_alerts_reset: The browser reset the permission, turn them on again
$bog_gram_text_crew_bad_id: This does not look like an ID
$bog_gram_text_crew_no_key_grant: Could not find this person's key: cannot grant them rights
$bog_gram_text_crew_no_key_read: Could not find this person's key: without it they cannot read the conversation
$bog_gram_text_crew_no_keys: Could not find the keys of all members: a new part of the conversation cannot be started without them
$bog_gram_text_invite_late: The other person's key was not found: most likely they have not opened Gram yet or are connected to a different master. Ask for a fresh link
$bog_gram_text_invite_lost: The link to the conversation is broken, ask for a fresh one
$bog_gram_text_invite_wait: Opening the conversation, looking for the other person's key
$bog_gram_text_lobby_denied_one: Your request was declined. You can ask again with the same link
$bog_gram_text_lobby_denied_some: Requests declined: {n}. You can ask again with the same links
$bog_gram_text_lobby_key_bad: The key in the request does not match its owner: request rejected
$bog_gram_text_lobby_lost: The link has no group creator, there is no one to take the request to. Ask for a fresh link
$bog_gram_text_lobby_queued_one: The request is being sent, it is not instant
$bog_gram_text_lobby_sent_one: Request sent, waiting for it to be accepted
$bog_gram_text_lobby_sent_some: Requests sent: {n}, waiting for them to be accepted
$bog_gram_text_voice_unsupported: Audio recording is not supported here

$bog_install_install_unsupported_browser: Installation is not supported in this browser.
